sources.title: Katie Zacharia is 'transitioning out' as press secretary, White House says
sources.excerpt: Katie Zacharia is "transitioning out" of her role as press secretary, according to a White House official not authorized to speak on the record, marking a stunning turn of events for the spokeswoman who officially started Monday and is out by Friday.
